hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The council leans toward a risk‑on stance driven by a broad set of long signals in a risk‑on cross‑asset regime. However, the conviction levels are modest and many alt‑coins lack meaningful volatility or risk metrics, making those signals fragile. BTC shows a slight positive edge, but ETH, SOL and LTC exhibit negative composites and higher volatility, suggesting caution. Overall we recommend a modest exposure scaling (0.8) and small conviction tweaks to temper the weaker signals while keeping a slight bias toward the long side.
